title: net1 v4 on its data rerun with the original setups' TCP limits, against a net1 retrained on it
description: net1 v4's three datasets were rerun with the same specs after the guest took Sage's and ccBench's 64 MB TCP buffer limits (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-38, -60s-39, -ood-40; before: releases 5, 8 and 9, with a 4 MB send buffer that capped buffer-filling flows on about 7% of the links). This trains one net1 with net1 v4's chosen settings (dropout 0.05, width 512, seed 0) on the new data and reports it next to net1 v4 itself (--compare) on the same new rows: whether net1 v4 is still honest on what the new guest produces decides whether it is kept.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-d0.05-w512-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --seed $SEED --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --compare "$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"
